description: Parameters for one procedurally generated pixel-art ship sprite. Version 1. All fields optional; omitted fields use the defaults below. Unknown fields are rejected by ship_factory.py.

cockpit.description: Whether to draw the bright cockpit canopy near the nose.

detail.description: How many deterministic panel/window details are sprinkled on the hull.

engine_glow.description: Whether to draw the fading engine exhaust at the tail.

faction.description: Faction palette key. Palettes live in factions.json; add a new faction there and extend this enum in the same change.

hull_length.description: Hull length in low-res pixels (before scaling). Longer = sleeker ship.

hull_width.description: Hull width in low-res pixels (before scaling).

scale.description: Nearest-neighbour upscale factor. Output PNG is (hull_length+10)*scale wide and (hull_width+14)*scale tall.

ship_params_version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 in this release. Bump only on a breaking change; new optional fields keep version 1.

voxel_slices.description: Number of horizontal slices the voxel-stack export emits (1..24). 0 = no voxel-stack model; the flat top-down PNG ignores this field.

wing_style.description: Wing shape. 'none' renders a wingless dart.

title: Pixel Ship Factory params
